name: Artifact Consumer
summary: Consumes immutable artifacts and needs corrected successor revisions without overwriting prior versions.
description: Works with immutable artifacts that may require bounded correction after publication or review. Uses artifact.revision-create to derive append-only successor metadata so a correction creates a new revision that supersedes an older one without destroying historical lineage.

distinguished_from.how: Consumes or governs immutable artifact revisions generically; does not create ecology-specific daily artwork.
Needs append-only artifact revision metadata and lineage preservation, rather than adjudicating unknown detections or updating a location-specific knowledge base.
